limitations.text: Trends are subject to rapid change: the report itself notes that culture now "ebbs and flows at the speed of the algorithm," so some insights may lose relevance sooner than expected .

Many data points come from self-reported surveys (e.g., 50 % say they try to ration their own screen-time and 40 % try to switch off as much as possible), which can suffer from social-desirability and recall bias .

Geographic representation is uneven: several statistics highlight specific markets such as Brazil, the US, the UK, China and Japan, so findings may not generalize to regions that were under-sampled or omitted  .
Evidence often relies on isolated brand case-studies (e.g., IKEA “Bonding Instruction” or Tusker Lager’s micro-LED kit) that may illustrate edge cases rather than widespread consumer behavior  .
